Classifier trained on the Jul-Oct closed cases (Vesta V/C/D/M features, unnamed) scores the flagged transaction 1.00; bank risk score was 0.28
Customer repeats that they did not make the purchase and still holds the card
Policy R2 was followed to block the card and create a case because the customer denied the transaction and the exposure was under $2,500.
Pattern 2 for card not present fraud applies here as the card number was used online without the cardholder's authorization while they still held the card.

case.summary: Customer C08299 reported transaction 3581141 for $30.02 as unauthorized on 2016-12-28. The customer confirmed they still possess the physical card and did not authorize the purchase. While the bank risk score was low at 0.28, a specialized classifier scored the transaction at 1.00. Following policy R2, the card was blocked after the customer denied the transaction. The investigation concludes this was card not present fraud with a total exposure of $30.02.
